dorsal_lateral_high_contrast_texture_top.macro_annuli_edge_geometry: Multiple 'O' and 'C' shaped light-intensity structures observed across the mid-section. Perimeter geometry shows sharp pixel intensity transitions from low (dark base) to high (light ring edge). Interior regions of these structures show a secondary gradient from high intensity back toward a medium-dark center.
dorsal_lateral_high_contrast_texture_top.high_intensity_blob_density: High spatial density of localized, solid high-intensity pixel clusters distributed throughout the patterned area. Core pixel concentrations are most frequent in the interstices between larger annuli and along the lower lateral boundary.
dorsal_lateral_high_contrast_texture_top.constellation_keypoints: Centroids of the three most prominent macro-annuli in the mid-dorsal region form an obtuse scalene triangle, with the longest side oriented roughly parallel to the animal's longitudinal axis.

other_distinctive_markers: The pattern exhibits a reticulated topology where high-intensity edges frequently intersect and merge, creating a contiguous lattice-like network across the visible torso.
